title: Deployment Platform Project Configuration
description: Generic, provider-agnostic description of a project and its environments. One deployment engine consumes this to produce a project-specific result. Contains NO secrets: secret material is referenced by name and supplied at runtime via the SecretProvider.

schema_version.description: Version of this configuration schema the file targets.

name.description: Unique project identity. Used to derive filesystem paths, container/network names, nginx config names, state and locks.

defaults.description: Optional values inherited by every environment unless overridden. Deep-merged with each environment before validation of the effective config.

environments.description: Map of environment name (e.g. staging, production) to its configuration.

identitySlug.description: Lowercase kebab-case identity segment used to build resource names.

environmentCommon.description: Fields that may appear either in defaults or in a specific environment.

allOf.description: Static deployments must declare how the artifact is built.

type.description: docker = long-running containers; static = build produces files that are published.

strategy.description: docker strategy. blue_green is default and required for reversible deploys.

allOf.description: strategy only applies to docker deployments.

target.description: Where and how the deployment is published. The engine resolves driver to a driver implementation.

targetCpanel.description: cPanel-based shared host. Auto-provisions the subdomain (and optionally an FTP account) via UAPI. API token supplied via SecretProvider (CPANEL_API_TOKEN), never here.

docroot.description: Docroot relative to home; default public_html/<subdomain>.

create_ftp.description: Also create a scoped FTP account.

secret_ref.description: Name of the secret holding the cPanel API token.

ref.description: ID of the VPS in the resource registry; resolves to host + credentials at runtime.

base_path.description: Root under which project deployments live.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the Hostinger account endpoint.

auth.description: ssh_key (preferred, enables atomic releases) or ftps (fallback). Key/password supplied via SecretProvider, never here.

transfer.description: Transfer mechanism. rsync (with ssh_key) is preferred.

secret_ref.description: Name of the secret (looked up via SecretProvider) holding the SSH key or FTPS password.

allOf.description: ftps auth cannot use rsync/scp transfer.

secret_ref.description: Name of the secret holding the Netlify auth token.

distribution_id.description: CDN distribution to invalidate after sync.

secret_ref.description: Name of the secret holding cloud credentials.

deployUser.description: Least-privilege Linux deployment identity for vps targets.

ssh_key_ref.description: Name of the secret holding the SSH private key.

build.description: How CI produces the static artifact. Language-independent: `command` is any shell command (npm/hugo/bundle/make/...). `output_dir` is OPTIONAL — if omitted, the platform auto-detects the folder the build created/changed (falling back to known names like dist/out/build/public). Omit `command` for a no-build site served as-is. Optionally run the build inside `image` so the toolchain isn't tied to the CI runner.

command.description: Build command (any language), e.g. 'npm ci && npm run build', 'hugo', 'bundle exec jekyll build'. Omit for no build.

output_dir.description: Optional. Directory to publish (e.g. 'dist','public','_site'). If omitted, auto-detected from what the build produced. Set it to be explicit / when detection is ambiguous.

image.description: Optional container image to run the build in (e.g. 'golang:1.22', 'ruby:3.3', 'klakegg/hugo'). Keeps the build toolchain independent of the runner.

node_version.description: Optional Node version hint (only relevant for Node builds).

spa.description: Single-page app (React Router, Vue Router, etc.). When true, the platform writes an Apache .htaccess into the published folder that rewrites all non-file requests to index.html, so deep links (e.g. /about) work on shared hosting like Hostinger. Ignored if `htaccess` is provided.

htaccess.description: Optional literal .htaccess contents to publish alongside the site (overrides `spa`). Use for custom redirects/headers. Written verbatim into the published folder.

database.description: Project/environment-scoped database. Migrations run only for this deployment.

image.description: Container image (docker deployments only). Deployment should use an immutable ref (…@sha or :<commit>).

env_refs.description: Names of environment/secret entries injected at runtime via SecretProvider. Names only, never values.

release_strategy.description: static only. symlink (atomic, SSH), mirror (rsync --delete), ftps_upload (least atomic fallback).

ssl.description: true = platform provisions the cert (Certbot on vps). 'managed_by_provider' = external host (e.g. Hostinger hPanel) owns SSL.

port.description: Optional fixed port. Omit to let the platform allocate one automatically (preferred, Rule 9).
